title: Choose the performance workspace
question: All three preserve SHUAMO’s paper-and-ink identity. Choose the structure that makes link activity and earnings easiest to understand.

options.label: Performance Pulse
options.thesis: A plain-language result statement leads into one selectable trend and a ranked source table.
options.viewport: Period controls and one decisive performance sentence lead; a restrained metric rail, single trend, and brand/product/link breakdown follow.
options.risk: The trend can dominate unless the source table remains visibly primary.

options.label: Brand Books
options.lineage: account books grouped by commercial relationship
options.thesis: Each brand becomes a compact performance chapter that opens from total to product to link.
options.viewport: A creator total is followed by brand chapters with earnings, clicks, orders, and expandable product rows.
options.risk: Cross-brand comparison takes more scanning than a single ranked table.

options.label: Source Explorer
options.thesis: A ranked source list and persistent inspector make every aggregate immediately auditable.
options.viewport: Totals and filters sit above a wide source table; selecting a row opens its link funnel and recent earning records beside it.
options.risk: The split view is powerful on desktop but must serialize carefully on phones.
